title: Application source repository
description: One git repository of an application (applications/<app_id>/repos/<repo_id>.json): where it lives, what it contains (IaC, Helm charts, LLM agent code), how it is built and protected, and the commit Maxwell last inspected. Written by refresh-ctx and probe-sdlc

appId.description: Slug of the owning application; equals the applications/<app_id> directory name

repoId.description: Slug of this repository; must equal the file name without .json and the localCheckout directory name

url.description: Clone URL in https://, ssh:// or scp-like git@host:org/repo(.git) form. A username without a password is allowed in https:// and ssh:// forms (Bitbucket Cloud, Gitea, Gerrit); percent-encoded path segments (Azure DevOps) are allowed; passwords, path traversal, trailing slashes and doubled .git suffixes are rejected

host.description: Hosting platform, used to pick the right API for branch-protection and CODEOWNERS probes

visibility.description: Repository visibility as reported by the host. 'internal' is visible to the whole organisation but not the public

pinnedCommit.description: Full or abbreviated SHA of the commit Maxwell last analysed. Every probe result for this repo refers to this commit

lastFetchedAt.description: When the local checkout was last fetched from the remote

languages.description: Programming and configuration languages present, most significant first. Use 'other' for anything not listed and note the detail in the app README

buildSystem.description: Primary build or dependency tool at the repository root; feeds the SBOM generation strategy. Required: write 'none' when the repository has no build tooling so that absence is never mistaken for 'not yet inspected'

ciSystem.description: CI/CD system that builds this repository, probed by probe-cicd-env. Required: write 'none' when no pipeline exists so that absence is never mistaken for 'not yet inspected'

packageManifests.description: Dependency manifests relative to the repository root (package.json, pom.xml, go.mod, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml and so on)

containsIac.description: True when infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible, CDK) is present

containsHelmChart.description: True when a Helm chart (Chart.yaml) or Kustomize overlays are present

containsAgentCode.description: True when LLM agent or harness code is present (prompt files, tool definitions, MCP servers, agent frameworks); routes the repo to probe-agent-graph and OWASP Agentic checks

codeownersPresent.description: True when a CODEOWNERS file exists at a location the host honours

localCheckout.description: Where the gitignored working copy lives inside the workspace; always applications/<app_id>/repos/<repo_id>

gitUrl.description: Alias of common gitUrl, kept for existing $refs

branchProtection.description: Protection rules on the default branch as reported by the host API

required.description: True when the default branch rejects direct pushes and requires pull requests

minApprovers.description: Minimum number of approving reviews before merge (0 when reviews are not enforced)

requireCodeOwnerReviews.description: True when a review from a CODEOWNERS owner is required for the paths a pull request touches; without it codeownersPresent is informational only (SSDF PW.2, SEBI CSCRF code review)

dismissStaleReviews.description: True when approving reviews are dismissed by new commits pushed to the pull request

statusChecks.description: Names of status checks that must pass before merge

requireSignedCommits.description: True when commits on the default branch must be GPG/SSH signed

requireLinearHistory.description: True when merge commits are forbidden on the default branch

enforceAdmins.description: True when the rules also apply to repository administrators and bypass lists are empty
